description: Adding a safety/privacy block cannot turn DENY into ALLOW.
Active suppression blocks automatic open, user open, and user continuation.
Disabling auto teaching blocks automatic opening but not explicit user opening.
Automatic session budget applies to new automatic opening, not current moment continuation.
Hard opening cooldown does not kill an active moment.
Hard protected flow blocks automatic execution but not latest explicit user request.
Hard attempt cap blocks retry but allows reveal.
Hard teaching-turn cap blocks nonterminal hint but allows terminal reveal.
Unknown critical state yields DEGRADED with no synthetic DENY.
Extraneous Planner factors cannot change Gate result.
Deny reason ordering is stable and input-order independent.
Continuation requires lock owned by current moment.
Changing latest user intent from teaching continuation blocks automatic continuation.
A terminalizing explanation may close a moment after hard turn cap.
